scripts.dev: concurrently -n FRONT,BACK,URLS -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev:front" "npm run dev:back" "node scripts/dev-urls.mjs"
scripts.dev:back: cd backend && poetry run uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload
